description: Free-text search across the full immigration catalog, including visas, residency-to-permanent-residency and citizenship pathways. Natural-language aliases such as "golden visa", "property residency", "pension visa" and "remote work visa" are recognized. Returns compact matches with reasons and program_ids; call get_program for one match's complete sourced record. For numeric minimum and presence filters on the three visa families, use find_visas.

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

limit.description: How many matching programs to return. Defaults to 25; count gives the total.

program_type.description: Only this program category. Defaults to "any".

query.description: Optional words to find across program names and details, e.g. "property investment", "pension" or "naturalization".

name: search_programs
title: Search immigration programs
